rules.prepare:
export MACHINE="`echo $AELTRA_HOST_TYPE | cut -d'-' -f1`"
cd "$AELTRA_SOURCE_DIR" sed -i 's/linux-mips64/linux64-mips64/g' config
cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR" $AELTRA_SOURCE_DIR/config \ --prefix="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX" \ --cross-compile-prefix="${AELTRA_HOST_TYPE}-" \ --openssldir="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib/ssl" \ --libdir=lib \ \ no-idea no-mdc2 no-rc5 no-zlib no-ssl3 no-ssl3-method \ no-async enable-rfc3779 enable-cms
rules.install:
cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR" make DESTDIR="$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR" install
mkdir -p "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/etc/ssl"
for item in certs openssl.cnf private; do mv "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib/ssl/$item" "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/etc/ssl/" ln -s "/etc/ssl/$item" "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib/ssl/" done
chmod 0700 "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/etc/ssl/private"
